title: Not what I expected
text: Not what I expected. Easy to install but very difficult to get the line to stay tight inorder for clothes to stay off the ground.

product_metadata.title: Minky Homecare Outdoor Retractable Clothesline - Heavy Duty PVC Coated Line - Energy and Space Saving Removable Laundry Drying Line - 49 Feet (Gray)
features: SUSTAINABLE CLOTHES DRYING – Save energy, money and time with the unmatched drying capacity of Minky Retractable Clotheslines
SPACE SAVING RETRACTABLE DESIGN - Easy to use backyard outdoor drying line, stows neatly away when not in use
HEAVY DUTY CLOTHES LINE - The strong PVC coated line is sunlight resistant and easy to wipe clean
EASY USE FOR ALL SEASONS - Fully retractable with UV stable protective casing, clothesline clips out of bracket for winter storage. Ideal for backyards, patios and balconies
MOUNTING HARDWARE INCLUDED - Includes wall attachment components for easy and stress-free setup.
description: The Minky Retractable washing line is ideal for small gardens, patios or balconies and provides a full 49-feet of drying space. The strong PVC coated line is sunlight resistant and easy to wipe clean. It attaches to the wall with a special bracket which means it can simply clip off for removal when not required.

details.Included Components: Screws, Mounting bracket w/ pins, Anchor screws, Line hooks, Clothesline Reel
